pages.notes: Single-page site; anchor-based navigation maps to in-page sections (#services, #portfolio, #about, #contact). All sections render on a single route.

components.notes: Implements Services dropdown (4 children) and 'Let's Talk' CTA button. Smooth-scroll to anchor sections on click.
Full-bleed background image (2044x1084) with headline + subheadline overlay and a single CTA.
4-column grid (Web Design, Mobile Apps, Brand Messaging, Build Interest). Each card is an icon + label link.
3-column process block: Schedule a Call / Craft a Plan / Realize Your Vision.
5-column featured projects gallery. All links point to external client sites (open in new tab). Source thumbnails are 49x34px low-res blur placeholders — must source full-res imagery for rebuild.

6-field contact form (firstName, lastName, company, projectType, email, phone). Submits to Next.js API route at /api/contact which forwards via Resend to merimeesoftware@gmail.com. Adds Cloudflare Turnstile for spam protection.
2-column layout: portrait (147x221 source) + bio paragraph. Bio mentions Wyoming Catholic College and Catholic publishing background.
4-column footer (logo, contact info, social links, copyright). Social links must open in new tabs with rel='noopener noreferrer'.

architecture_decisions.decision: Single SSG page at '/' with anchor-based section navigation
architecture_decisions.rationale: SiteUnderstanding confirms 1 page discovered and 404 on /about path. Navigation uses in-page anchors (#services, #portfolio, #about, #contact). No additional routes required for v1.
alternatives_considered: Multi-page route split (e.g., /services, /portfolio, /about, /contact) with shared layout
Astro with view transitions for section changes

architecture_decisions.decision: Preserve all 5 external portfolio links; do not host client sites
architecture_decisions.rationale: Portfolio items point to domains owned by other clients (holyrollers.us, akronchestertonacademy.org, parkereidle.com, alenacarter.art, bonfiremedia.art). These must remain external, opening in new tabs.
alternatives_considered: Build case-study pages with screenshots of each project
Add nofollow/dofollow attributes (recommend nofollow for paid/affiliate work)

architecture_decisions.rationale: Site uses a clean component grid (4-col cards, 5-col gallery, 3-col process) that maps well to utility classes. Single-page marketing site benefits from rapid styling iteration. No complex brand system in source to preserve.
alternatives_considered: CSS Modules with a small design tokens file
Plain CSS with custom properties

architecture_decisions.decision: No CMS — content lives in code as typed data files
architecture_decisions.rationale: Total text content is 298 words across 1 page with low update frequency. No blog, no e-commerce, no multi-author. A CMS would add operational overhead with no benefit.
alternatives_considered: Sanity (overkill for this scope)
Markdown content collections in /content (future-proof if blog is added later)
Headless CMS via Contentful

architecture_decisions.decision: Defer CMS until second iteration; design copy structure so a CMS can be retrofitted
architecture_decisions.rationale: Portfolio and bio content may grow. Storing services/projects/about as typed arrays in a single content module allows a future swap to MDX or headless CMS without component changes.
alternatives_considered: MDX content collections from day one

architecture_decisions.decision: Next.js Route Handler at /api/contact with Resend for email delivery and Cloudflare Turnstile for spam
architecture_decisions.rationale: Wix form posts to a Wix-managed endpoint. Rebuilding requires a serverless handler. Resend gives simple transactional email; Turnstile is privacy-friendly and free. All secrets stay on the server.
alternatives_considered: Formspree third-party endpoint (vendor lock-in, no custom validation)
Netlify Forms (only works on Netlify)
Direct SMTP via Nodemailer (heavier ops)

architecture_decisions.decision: Download all wixstatic.com assets to /public and serve via next/image
architecture_decisions.rationale: Static.wixstatic.com URLs include transform params (w_/h_/enc_avif) that may break if Wix changes their CDN. Local hosting gives full ownership, deterministic URLs, and lets next/image generate responsive srcsets.
alternatives_considered: Preserve CDN URLs (risk: links rot, no responsive optimization)
Upload to Cloudflare R2 (adds a dependency for a small asset set)

architecture_decisions.decision: Replace low-res 49x34 portfolio thumbnails with full-resolution imagery
architecture_decisions.rationale: SiteUnderstanding explicitly flags portfolio thumbnails as low-res blur placeholders. Rebuild must source higher-resolution images from the client or re-screenshot client sites.
alternatives_considered: Use the blur placeholders as-is (poor quality)
Skip thumbnails and use text-only cards

architecture_decisions.decision: Generate a single 1200x630 og/home.png for social sharing
architecture_decisions.rationale: Source og:image is a Wix-generated asset with transform params. Generating a static, optimized PNG/AVIF gives predictable social previews.
alternatives_considered: Preserve Wix og:image URL (rot risk)
Dynamic OG image via @vercel/og (overkill for 1 page)

architecture_decisions.decision: Add sitemap.xml and robots.txt (source has neither)
architecture_decisions.rationale: SiteUnderstanding flags no sitemap and no robots. Next.js can generate both at build via app/sitemap.ts and app/robots.ts.
alternatives_considered: Hand-write static files in /public

architecture_decisions.decision: Add Organization and Person JSON-LD (source has empty json_ld array)
architecture_decisions.rationale: Empty JSON-LD on a local business site is a missed SEO opportunity. Person schema for Michael Merimee + Organization schema for Merimee Digital Solutions will surface in Google knowledge panels.
alternatives_considered: Skip structured data (status quo from Wix)
Add only Organization (skip Person for privacy)

warnings: Single-page architecture limits long-tail SEO surface area; consider expanding to a real /services and /portfolio route in a future iteration if content grows.
Portfolio thumbnails in source are 49x34px blur placeholders — full-resolution imagery must be sourced separately from the client before the gallery can be built.
Source has no sitemap.xml and no robots.txt — both must be generated as part of the rebuild.
Source has empty json_ld array — opportunity to add Organization + Person schema in the rebuild (and a small SEO win).
'Build Interest' service label is ambiguous in the source; consider renaming to 'Advertising' or 'Growth Marketing' in the rebuild for clarity. Confirm with client before changing.
Wix form submission endpoint behavior is unknown; the rebuild should validate that all 6 fields persist server-side and that spam protection (Turnstile) is enabled before launch.
External portfolio links (5 client sites) should be checked for liveness before launch; broken outbound links hurt SEO.
Fly region 'cle' (Cleveland) chosen based on 440 area code in source contact info; confirm with client if a different region is preferred.
reasoning_trace: Step 1: Identified platform as Wix Studio with 0.95 confidence — confirmed by wixstudio.com subdomain, Wix.com Website Builder meta tag, and wix-thunderbolt scripts.
Step 2: Confirmed single-page architecture: total_pages_discovered=1, 404 on /about, navigation uses #anchors only.
Step 3: Inventoried 7 distinct component types on the home page (hero, cards, text_block x2, gallery, form, footer) plus a nav. Mapped each to a target-stack component.
Step 4: Counted text corpus (298 words) and assessed update frequency as low (no blog, no CMS markers) — SSG with static data files is sufficient.
Step 5: Selected Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind + SSG because: small marketing site, single page, no real-time data, SEO matters, team default.
Step 6: Decided against a CMS (Sanity, Contentful) because content volume and update frequency do not justify the operational overhead.

Step 7: Planned image migration as local-public: download all wixstatic.com assets to /public at build setup, use next/image for responsive srcsets. Flagged that 5 portfolio thumbnails are low-res and need higher-res replacements.

Step 8: Designed SEO migration: permanent redirect from wixstudio.com subdomain to new production domain; preserve anchor section URLs; regenerate og:image; add Organization + Person JSON-LD (new addition, since source has none).

Step 9: Designed deployment: Fly.io app 'merimee-solutions' in cle region (440 area code suggests Cleveland), GitHub repo MtMerimee/merimee-solutions, main branch with preview/ prefix for PR previews. Contact form needs Resend API key + Turnstile secret stored as Fly secrets.
Step 10: Estimated 14 build hours: 1 page, 8 components (mostly simple), 1 form with serverless handler, no CMS integration, no auth. Single developer, end-to-end.

Step 11: Set confidence to 0.88: high confidence on stack and routing (clear single-page pattern); medium confidence on content fidelity (low-res thumbnails and ambiguous 'Build Interest' label require client clarification); no blockers.
